query:
DELETE FROM deadlock_players p
        USING account_links l
        WHERE l.discord_id = p.discord_id
          AND l.provider = 'steam'
          AND CASE
                  WHEN l.external_id ~ '^[0-9]{17}$'
                  THEN l.external_id::bigint - 76561197960265728
              END <> p.account_id
